department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
benefit: You get a basic savings bank account. You do not need to keep any minimum balance. Your money earns interest. You get a RuPay debit card with accident insurance of Rs 2,00,000 (for accounts opened after 28 August 2018). Eligible account holders can get an overdraft of up to Rs 10,000.

other: For people who do not have any other bank account.

how_to_apply: Go to any bank branch or a Bank Mitra (Business Correspondent) outlet and ask to open a PMJDY account.
where_to_apply: Any bank branch or Business Correspondent (Bank Mitra) outlet
